
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/blxt/p/22776709" title="发布于 2026-08-31 16:28">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">K8S接入NFS存储</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        
        本文详细演示了在Kubernetes集群中接入NFS作为默认持久化存储的完整流程。针对容器数据易失问题，文章介绍了如何部署NFS Provisioner，并配置StorageClass将其设为集群默认（default）。通过此方案，实现了PVC的动态自动供给，开发者无需手动创建PV即可为Pod分配存储。该方案利用NFS的共享特性，有效简化了K8s存储管理，提升了运维效率与数据安全性。
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<h2 id="一部署nfs服务端">一、部署NFS服务端</h2>
<h3 id="安装nfs服务">安装NFS服务</h3>
<h4 id="ubuntudebian">Ubuntu/Debian</h4>
<pre><code class="language-bash">sudo apt update
sudo apt install nfs-kernel-server -y
</code></pre>
<h4 id="centosrhel--rocky--almalinux">Centos/<font style="color: rgba(29, 29, 31, 1)">RHEL / Rocky / AlmaLinux</font></h4>
<pre><code class="language-bash">sudo dnf install -y  nfs-utils
</code></pre>
<h3 id="创建共享目录">创建共享目录</h3>
<pre><code class="language-bash">sudo mkdir -p 路径及目录名
</code></pre>
<h3 id="配置nfs配置文件">配置NFS配置文件</h3>
<pre><code class="language-bash">sudo vim /etc/exports
增加以下内容
/opt/nfs x.x.x.x/xx(rw,sync,no_subtree_check,no_root_squash)   # x.x.x.x/xx替换为需要访问nfs的网段或地址
</code></pre>
<h4 id="参数说明">参数说明：</h4>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th style="text-align: center">参数</th>
<th style="text-align: center">说明</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center">rw</td>
<td style="text-align: center">客户端可读写</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center">ro</td>
<td style="text-align: center">客户端只读</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center">sync</td>
<td style="text-align: center">数据同步写入磁盘，更安全</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center">async</td>
<td style="text-align: center">数据异步写入，性能好但是有一定风险</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center">no_subtree_check</td>
<td style="text-align: center">不检查子目录，推荐开启</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center">root_squash</td>
<td style="text-align: center">客户端 root 用户映射为匿名用户</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center">no_root_squash</td>
<td style="text-align: center">客户端 root 用户保留 root 权限，风险较高</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center">all_squash</td>
<td style="text-align: center">所有用户都映射为匿名用户</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center">anonuid/anongid</td>
<td style="text-align: center">指定匿名用户 UID/GID</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<h3 id="应用配置">应用配置</h3>
<pre><code class="language-bash">sudo exportfs -rav
</code></pre>
<h3 id="重启服务并设置开机自启动">重启服务并设置开机自启动</h3>
<h4 id="ubuntudebian-1">Ubuntu/Debian</h4>
<pre><code class="language-bash">sudo systemctl restart nfs-kernel-server
sudo systemctl enable nfs-kernel-server
sudo systemctl status nfs-kernel-server
</code></pre>
<h4 id="centos--rhel--rocky--almalinux"><font style="color: rgba(29, 29, 31, 1)">CentOS / RHEL / Rocky / AlmaLinux</font></h4>
<pre><code class="language-bash">sudo systemctl enable --now nfs-server
sudo systemctl status nfs-server
</code></pre>
<h3 id="安全配置内网可忽略">安全配置（内网可忽略）</h3>
<h4 id="放通防火墙">放通防火墙</h4>
<h5 id="ubuntudebian-2">Ubuntu/Debian</h5>
<pre><code class="language-bash">sudo ufw allow from 192.168.1.0/24 to any port 2049 proto tcp
sudo ufw allow from 192.168.1.0/24 to any port 2049 proto udp
sudo ufw allow from 192.168.1.0/24 to any port 111 proto tcp
sudo ufw allow from 192.168.1.0/24 to any port 111 proto udp
sudo ufw allow from 192.168.1.0/24 to any port 20048 proto tcp
sudo ufw allow from 192.168.1.0/24 to any port 20048 proto udp
</code></pre>
<p>或者</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">sudo ufw allow proto tcp to any port nfs
sudo ufw allow proto udp to any port nfs
sudo ufw allow proto tcp to any port rpcbind
sudo ufw allow proto udp to any port rpcbind
</code></pre>
<h5 id="centos--rhel--rocky--almalinux-1"><font style="color: rgba(29, 29, 31, 1)">CentOS / RHEL / Rocky / AlmaLinux</font></h5>
<pre><code class="language-bash">sudo firewall-cmd --permanent --add-service=nfs
sudo firewall-cmd --permanent --add-service=mountd
sudo firewall-cmd --permanent --add-service=rpc-bind
sudo firewall-cmd --reload
</code></pre>
<h4 id="云服务器安全组中要放开以下端口可选">云服务器安全组中要放开以下端口（可选）</h4>
<pre><code class="language-bash">TCP 2049
UDP 2049
TCP 111
UDP 111
TCP 20048
UDP 20048
</code></pre>
<h2 id="二k8s接入nfs存储">二、K8S接入NFS存储</h2>
<h3 id="所有k8s节点安装nfs客户端">所有K8S节点安装NFS客户端</h3>
<h4 id="ubuntu--debian"><font style="color: rgba(29, 29, 31, 1)">Ubuntu / Debian</font></h4>
<pre><code class="language-bash">sudo apt update
sudo apt install -y nfs-common
</code></pre>
<h4 id="centos--rhel--rocky--almalinux-2"><font style="color: rgba(29, 29, 31, 1)">CentOS / RHEL / Rocky / AlmaLinux</font></h4>
<pre><code class="language-bash">sudo dnf install -y nfs-utils
</code></pre>
<h4 id="测试节点是否可以挂载">测试节点是否可以挂载</h4>
<pre><code class="language-bash">showmount -e nfs-ip
</code></pre>
<p>输出内容类似下面这些</p>
<blockquote>
<p>Export list for 192.168.1.10:</p>
<p>/srv/nfs/k8s 192.168.1.0/24</p>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="master节点安装helm">Master节点安装helm</h3>
<pre><code class="language-bash">curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/helm/helm/main/scripts/get-helm-3 | sudo bash
</code></pre>
<p>如果下载超时可以先在外面下载好再上传到服务器上</p>
<blockquote>
<p><a href="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/helm/helm/main/scripts/get-helm-3" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://raw.githubusercontent.com/helm/helm/main/scripts/get-helm-3</a></p>
</blockquote>
<p>然后执行bash</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">bash helm3-filename 	# helm3-filename下载的文件名
</code></pre>
<p>测试是否安装成功</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">helm version		# 如果有输出版本信息即安装成功，提示无次命令安装失败
</code></pre>
<h3 id="master节点下载chart包">Master节点下载chart包</h3>
<p>下载地址：</p>
<blockquote>
<p><a href="https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/nfs-subdir-external-provisioner/releases/download/nfs-subdir-external-provisioner-4.0.18/nfs-subdir-external-provisioner-4.0.18.tgz" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/nfs-subdir-external-provisioner/releases/download/nfs-subdir-external-provisioner-4.0.18/nfs-subdir-external-provisioner-4.0.18.tgz</a> 	# 由于github下载需要再外网下载好传输到服务器中</p>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="安装chart">安装chart</h3>
<pre><code class="language-bash">helm install nfs-provisioner ./nfs-subdir-external-provisioner-4.0.18.tgz \
  --namespace nfs-provisioner --create-namespace \
  --set nfs.server=nfs-ip \						# 此处nfs-ip改成NFS服务器的IP地址
  --set nfs.path=nfs-filename \				# 此处nfs-filename改成NFS共享目录
  --set storageClass.name=nfs \
  --set storageClass.defaultClass=true \
  --set storageClass.reclaimPolicy=Retain \
  --set storageClass.archiveOnDelete=true
</code></pre>
<h3 id="验证状态">验证状态</h3>
<pre><code class="language-bash">kubectl get pods -n nfs-provisioner		# 查看容器运行状态
kubectl get  storageclass		# 查看存储类
</code></pre>
<p>创建PVC，新建yaml文件添加以下内容</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: tmp-pvc
  namespace: default
spec:
  accessModes:
    - ReadWriteOnce
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 1Gi
</code></pre>
<p>执行yaml文件</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">kubectl apply -f xxx.yaml		# xxx.yaml替换成上面创建的yaml文件
kubectl get pvc		# 查看PVC是否创建
kubectl delete pvc pvc-name		# 删除PVC，PVC-name替换为你的PVC名称
</code></pre>


</div>
